actions.label: Wi-Fi
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == "enabled" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Bluetooth
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && bluetoothctl power on || bluetoothctl power off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(bluetoothctl show | grep -c "Powered: yes") -gt 0 ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Performance
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && busctl --system set-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile s performance || busctl --system set-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile s balanced'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'busctl --system get-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile 2>/dev/null | grep -q performance && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Balanced
actions.command: sh -c 'busctl --system set-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile s balanced'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'busctl --system get-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile 2>/dev/null | grep -q balanced && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Power Saver
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && busctl --system set-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile s power-saver || busctl --system set-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile s balanced'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'busctl --system get-property net.hadess.PowerProfiles /net/hadess/PowerProfiles net.hadess.PowerProfiles ActiveProfile 2>/dev/null | grep -q power-saver && echo true || echo false'
